finalText:
**Good call, one wasn't noise.** The build was actually failing, not just warning.

Two real bugs, both from the same bump:
1. The options shape changed. `retries` is now `retryCount`. `src/core/options.js` reads either name now.
2. Unset flags come back `undefined`, not `false`. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treats unset as off again.

`node build.js` now exits 0. Retry budget 3, backoff disabled.

The other 8 warnings are noise from the bumped packages. They point at files this repo does not have.
